bill.title: Cahokia Mounds Mississippian Culture Study Act
bill.latestActionText: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 478.
bill.officialSummary: Cahokia Mounds Mississippian Culture Study Act This bill directs the Department of the Interior to conduct a special resource study of an area made up of (1) Cahokia Mounds State Historic Site in Collinsville, IL; (2) the Emerald Mounds in St. Clair County, Illinois; and (3) the Pulcher Mounds in Monroe and St. Clair Counties, Illinois. (The National Park Service uses special resource studies when determining whether to designate sites as National Historical Sites.) The study must evaluate the national significance of the study area; determine the suitability and feasibility of designating the study area as a unit of the National Park System; consider other alternatives for preservation, protection, and interpretation of the study area by other governmental entities or nonprofit organizations; and identify cost estimates for any federal acquisition, development, interpretation, operation, and maintenance associated with such alternatives. Interior must report on the results of the study and make recommendations to specified congressional committees.

classification.plainSummary: This bill directs the Department of the Interior to study three historic mound sites in Illinois—Cahokia Mounds, Emerald Mounds, and Pulcher Mounds—to determine whether they should be designated as a unit of the National Park System. The study would assess the sites' national significance, evaluate whether federal designation is suitable and feasible, consider alternative preservation approaches by other organizations, and estimate costs for federal acquisition and management. Interior would then report its findings and recommendations to Congress.

industries.rationale: National Park designation could affect regional tourism infrastructure and visitor services around the historic sites.
Federal acquisition of land for park designation could affect property values and development rights in the study area.

plain.whatItDoes: This bill would order the Interior Department to conduct a special resource study of an area made up of (1) Cahokia Mounds State Historic Site in Collinsville, IL; (2) the Emerald Mounds in St. Clair County, Illinois; and (3) the Pulcher Mounds in Monroe and St. Clair Counties, Illinois.

plain.everydayEffect: If it passed, the change would show up in what may be done on that land. Nothing has changed yet. Most bills never become law.
